name: netflix_tudum2025_trailer

source.title: Netflix Tudum 2025 | Official Trailer | May 31 | Netflix
source.note: source fields fixed by hand (title contains |)

cuts.method: cuts2.py adaptive detector (ratio 3.0, abs 0.25); black flashes folded by stats2.py; spot-checked by eye on verify pairs + sheet

beatsync: onsets/s 0.91 cuts on onset (+-0.1s) 39 % vs chance 17 %
empty_frame: mostly-empty 27% (on dark 27%, on light 0%), median empty share 60%
manual_corrections: Trimmed to 76.8 s (end screen). Dropped 6 word-change events on black cards from the cut list (see manual.cut_definition), added 3 soft transitions. 51.59-51.72 is a real 3-frame dark flash between clips. Beatsync after correction: 36 % on onsets vs 18 % chance.

manual.trim_reason: 77.1-90.0 s is the YouTube end screen (N + SUBSCRIBE)
manual.letterbox: 2.00:1 inside 16:9 (active ~854x428, bars ~26 px = 5.4% H), type cards also letterboxed

corner_bug.~7.5-12 s (first event shots; start read: top-left red vertical rule + 'NETFLIX / TUDUM 2025' white sans ~2% H; top-right grey N monogram ~7.5% H (first event footage after the logo open)
corner_bug.12-66 s: 'NETFLIX' wordmark top-right ~4% H on footage; hidden on black type cards and show-logo cards

manual.cut_definition: picture cuts only: 6 detector hits that were words added on the same black type card (11.14, 17.98, 18.77, 22.44, 22.73, 27.57) were dropped from the shot count; 3 soft transitions added (7.2 light-bar wipe into the crowd, 12.0 light-streak wipe, 67.7 fade-up of the logo after black)

text_change_events.note: word-by-word builds on black, a new word every 0.17-0.5 s; with the 74 picture cuts this is ~88 edit events in 76.8 s = one every 0.87 s
text_change_events.timing_tolerance: word times read off a 6 fps strip whose labels can be up to 0.17 s early; true times are 0-0.17 s later

n_sting.where: only at the end, after the date card
n_sting.look: multicolour light bars (73.3-74.1) collapse into the red N (74.1-74.7 ribbon build), N held on black to 76.5; audio bump 74.5 s (-24 -> -12 dBFS), probably the ta-dum (guess)

logo_open.look: chrome-extruded 3D TUDUM letters (blue -> magenta -> red -> orange per letter) with small red NETFLIX wordmark above and red 2025 tag below, over a spectral light-streak floor that rushes toward camera; camera pushes in and flies over the letters (5.6-6.8), light bars wipe into the event crowd at 7.2

text_cards.style: red rounded LIVE badge with record dot + neon glow, white ON, red NETFLIX wordmark, over the light-streak floor; badge pops bigger at 11.1
word-by-word, white heavy geometric caps with spectral edge glow (cyan->violet->red->amber left to right) over the light-streak floor

text_cards.words: THE / BIGGEST / FANDOMS -> IN -> THE -> WORLD
text_cards.style: words on black, new word every 0.17-0.5 s; WORLD (~12% H) sits over split-screen footage with a vertical light-streak divider

text_cards.words: FROM THE -> SHOWS & FILMS / YOU LOVE
show logos: Happy Gilmore 2, Wednesday, Wake Up Dead Man, One Piece, Squid Game 3, Stranger Things 5, Frankenstein, The Rip
text_cards.style: each show's own logo on black/its own texture, alternating with 1-2 clips of that show

text_cards.words: FEATURING YOUR FAVORITE STARS FROM: + list of 14 titles
text_cards.style: small credit-list block, lines build down
fades up from 1 s of black/silence, lands on a +54 dB hit at 67.75

text_cards.words: LIVE ON NETFLIX / SATURDAY / MAY 31 / 8 PM ET | 5 PM PT
text_cards.style: white Netflix-Sans-like medium/bold, LIVE badge in eyebrow, coloured light bars at the left/right edges

audio_events.pre_logo_silence: 66.75-67.5 s down to -62 dBFS (0.75 s) under 1 s of black after Adam Sandler's line, then +54 dB hit at 67.75 s (-8 dBFS) on the TUDUM logo
audio_events.date_card: music drops to -37 dBFS under the date card (72-73 s)
audio_events.outro: N bump 74.5 s then fade to -58 by 76.5

timing_note: All times come from cut detection, cand.py/ffmpeg -ss frames or audio; strip-timed values are flagged. Contact-sheet tile k shows the frame at ~k+0.96 s.
